status.description: A receipt EXISTS only for a completed handoff. Withheld approval or a control-plane failure is a stage failure routed to the human queue, never a schema-valid receipt.

release_ref.description: Immutable reference of the release that was handed off.

approver.description: The accountable NAMED human who approved the handoff — intentional audit content (named-human accountability is a design invariant), not incidental PII; redact everything else.

audit_id.description: Producer-stamped deterministic provenance id: UUIDv5(HOUSE_NS, "release-handoff:{idempotency_key}") with HOUSE_NS = uuid5(NAMESPACE_URL, "https://squad-delivery/audit"). The human decision is logged in the gate/HITL record, not under this artifact id. Distinct from the engine's per-attempt execution audit id.

target_env.description: The environment the release was handed off to; idempotency identity is (idempotency_key, release_ref, target_env).

approval_ref.description: Optional reference to the authoritative gate/HITL approval record.
